difficulty_reason: The modular representation decomposition interacts with Frobenius powers and changing quasi-invariance thresholds. The proof constructs explicit free generators across the powers-of-two transition and proves completeness through a representation-sensitive induction, rather than checking that the displayed polynomials satisfy the defining divisibility condition.
